## History

Hammond worked at a small sawmill up the river and raised eight children, which included three sets of twins, with his wife. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived with his family for over two years to help care for his children. Hammond subsequently died, causing his wife to disband the household.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)_
